emailHtml:
Cert List · 5 item(s) to confirm · 4 posted to Teams

Teams channel cert-expiry-reminder gets only confirmed items (4). The 5 below need a decision or a page fix before they can be posted.

No environment filled in (2)

These look actionable but the page does not say where the certificate lives, so they are not posted to Teams.

CertificateValidity endStatus
Digital Sign API - for Client Cert via mTLS call05 Jan 2026overdue 312 days
API Gateway14 May 2026overdue 183 days

Cannot read a date (1)

Write a real date in the VALIDITY END cell (e.g. 04 Dec 2026) - prose like "renewed yearly" is not parseable.

EnvironmentCertificateCell says
SITgccsit-intra.example-certs.internal"renewed yearly"

Expired more than 12 months ago (1)

Almost certainly stale rows rather than renewal tasks - update the date or mark the row retired.

EnvironmentCertificateValidity end
SITlegacy-thing03 Feb 2019

Duplicate rows on the page (1)

The same environment + certificate + date appears more than once; merged for this report.

EnvironmentCertificateValidity end
DEVgccdev-intra.example-certs.internal24 Mar 2026

What to do

  1. Book the renewal / re-certification before the validity end date.
  2. Once renewed, update the VALIDITY END cell on the Cert List page (write the new date, not just "renewed").
  3. If you cannot renew in time, reply in the Teams thread with the reason and a committed target date.
  4. Fill in ENV and remove duplicate rows so the next run can post them as confirmed.

2 row(s) keep the key elsewhere (SSM / Keycloak / Imperva / non-expiring keys) - no expiry tracked on this page.
